name: com.listomancy/lists
description: Search checklists, read them as data and publish new lists behind a shareable link.

tools.name: search_lists
tools.description: Search Listomancy's hand-written checklists and routines by words (every word must match the title, description or an item). Empty query lists them all. Returns title, description, item count and the page URL.

language.description: Catalogue language. Default en. Each language has its own catalogue; results are never mixed.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "wedding" or "skincare evening".

tools.name: get_list
tools.description: Full content of one list by slug (the last part of its URL): sections with their items, plus the page, Markdown, Todoist CSV and text export URLs, the embed URL and a QR code URL.

tools.name: create_list
tools.description: Publish a new list and get its public link (page, exports, QR). Give either "items" (flat) or "sections" (grouped). Lists are immutable and unlisted (not indexed, not in the catalogue); to change one, create a new one with from_slug. Without an API key: 5 lists per day; with a key from register_agent: 50.

items.description: Flat list of items, in order.

language.description: Language of the list. Default en.

from_slug.description: Slug of the list this one is a modified copy of.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Optional. Issue an API key for your agent (shown once, keep it) and send it as "Authorization: Bearer <key>" to get higher rate limits (120 requests per minute, 50 created lists per day). Not needed to read or to create a few lists.

name.description: Name of your agent or client, e.g. "Acme research assistant".
